title: 3.0.0 release notes revision regarding xDrip
body:
**Currently release notes say:**
> There is a bug in xDrip and Dexcom native mode producing duplicated data which prevents AAPS from running in Closed loop mode.


**This has been fixed according @andyrozman:**
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/1979


**Pull request is not possible here. I propose to change these sentences:**

Old state:
> There is a bug in xDrip and Dexcom native mode producing duplicated data which prevents AAPS from running in Closed loop mode. Until this get fixed using BYODA in mandatory. Using BYODA is also recommended to take advantage of Dexcom back-smoothing

New state (deleting first 2 outdated sentences):
> Using BYODA is recommended to take advantage of Dexcom back-smoothing

Old state:
> if you are using G5/G6 switch to BYODA (recommended) - you still can use xDrip but not as collector (xDrip can receive data from BYODA) or update xDrip to latest nightly version

New state ("but not as collector" - is confusing):
> if you are using G5/G6 and xDrip as a collector, you have to update xDrip to a nightly version newer than 14th January 2022
> if you are using G5/G6 switching to BYODA as collector is recommended (you can still use xDrip for other purposes, xDrip can receive data from BYODA)


**Occurances (known to me):**
release notes on https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/releases
release notes in the documentation
Facebook posts with release notes
